title: Mosque–Cathedral of Córdoba
axis: +X generally east along the Orange Court’s front; +Z from the courtyard toward the mosque.

nativeAxes.z: from the courtyard to the south wall

source: Named Mosque–Cathedral Q33200, OSM current outer and courtyard rings
identityStatus: The named Q33200 OpenStreetMap multipolygon establishes the exact outer wall and courtyard opening. 137 attached map parts and 20 doors support subdivision, profiles, buttress and portal placement. The Mosque–Cathedral’s own records guide dimensions where the maps disagree.

terrainContact.basis: Original grade just north of the Puerta del Perdón at the courtyard entry.

notes: The official monument measures the bell tower at 54 m. The 1870s archive and 1905 courtyard print show persistent arch proportions, low surrounding gallery and layered belfry. The contemporary dedication carried by Qualla supports visible stone tones and horseshoe profile. The Renaissance nave and crossing stand above rows of terracotta mosque roofs.
